title: Bitcoin sinks under $90K: BitMine, Bitwise execs tip bottom this week
summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan said a price bottom is coming soon and will present a “generational opportunity” and a “gift for long-term investors.”

title: Crypto bank AMINA gets Hong Kong license to launch institutional trading
summary: Crypto-friendly AMINA Bank has secured a license to expand its institutional crypto services in Hong Kong, a market where crypto trading volumes rose 233% in the first half of 2025.

title: VanEck Solana ETF goes live, Grayscale DOGE ETF expected on Monday
summary: The flood of crypto ETFs has begun, with VanEck’s Solana ETF launching on Monday, and many more ETFs expected to go live over the next week.

title: XRP ‘structurally fragile’ as 41.5% of supply at a loss
summary: XRP supply in profit is at its lowest levels in 12 months, and one analyst has warned of further downside if investors decide to cut their losses. Could XRP ETFs bring the bulls back?

title: Digital Chamber seeks to guide crypto policy across US states
summary: Cody Carbone, CEO of The Digital Chamber, said in a statement that through collaboration with nonprofit Future Caucus, the initiative hopes to develop leaders ready to introduce and support crypto legislation.

title: White House weighs IRS bid to tax foreign crypto accounts via CARF
summary: The White House is reviewing a proposal to join an international crypto tax standard that could deter Americans from moving their digital assets to offshore exchanges.

title: Crypto firm LevelField secures Illinois approval to buy Chicago bank
summary: LevelField could become the first crypto-friendly FDIC-insured bank to offer crypto services after receiving approval from the Illinois financial regulator to acquire Burling Bank.

title: ETH falls to 4-month low under $3K: Is the bull market over?
summary: ETH price fell below $3,000 for the first time since July. Cointelegraph explains what is required for a trend reversal.

title: Aave launches retail savings app with up to 9% APY to compete with banks
summary: With higher yields and flexible deposits, Aave’s new app marks a deeper move into the consumer banking terrain as inflation drives demand for better savings tools.

title: How market structure votes could influence 2026 crypto voters
summary: A community director at the advocacy organization Stand With Crypto said US lawmakers’ voting records on a pending market structure bill could impact their reelection chances.
